She gave Krishna fruit for a handful of grain, and her basket filled with jewels. As the story goes, an old fruit seller walked through Gokul calling, fruits, fruits for sale.
Little Krishna heard her. He grabbed a handful of grain from the store, and ran out. But by the time he reached her, most of it had slipped through his tiny fingers. Just a few grains left.
She laughed, and filled his arms with fruits anyway. Wait, what happened next? When she lifted her basket, it was heavy. Full of gold, rubies and pearls. Those few grains had become jewels.
That's why we give to God first. However small. He returns it a thousand times. Comment Gopal if you give first.
